title: Multi-SF RX unimplemented: gateway all-SF7-12 RX/scan and node receive-on-all-SF7-12
description:
Req R-02-011 (spec/02-physical-link.md 3.4, MUST): 'Gateways MUST receive on all SF7-SF12 (multi-SF RX or CAD/round-robin scan).'
Req R-02-015 (spec/02-physical-link.md 3.5, MUST): 'Nodes MUST receive on all SF7-SF12.'

Classification: not-implemented.
Evidence: C CONFIG_LICHEN_GATEWAY_MULTI_SF default n with comment-only wiring (lichen/subsys/lichen/l2/Kconfig:198-205; lichen/subsys/lichen/l2/lora_l2.c:261-268); Python model-only function must_receive_all_sf with zero consumers (python/src/lichen/link/sf_assignment.py:79-81); Rust gateway has no multi-SF scan (search negative in rust/lichen-gateway).
Related SHOULD R-02-012 (gateway SHOULD advertise multi-SF capability in DIO) also absent; noted in matrix, not filed separately.

Suggested placement: gateway CAD/round-robin SF scan in C L2 + rust/lichen-gateway RX; node RX-wide SF filter widening.
